sentences.text: Propristis was an extinct genus of sawfish, a member of the class Chondrichthyes.
This animal belongs to the family Pristidae.
The genus was first described by Dames in 1883.
The type species of the genus is Propristis schweinfurthi.
A second valid species, Propristis mayumbensis, was described by Dartevelle and Casier in 1943.
The most common fossil remains are isolated rostral denticles, though complete rostra have also been discovered.
These creatures lived from the Ypresian to the Chattian stages, between 56 and 23.04 million years ago.
Fossils have been found in Egypt, Cabinda, Morocco, Qatar, Spain, the United Kingdom, and the United States.
